name: Airtable
description: Reads every record of an Airtable table, or of one of its views, through the Airtable REST API, one record per row.
introductoryText:
Reads all the records of an Airtable table into Omniscope, page by page, with the record ID first and one field per Airtable field.

**How to set it up**

1. Create a personal access token at https://airtable.com/create/tokens with the `data.records:read` scope and access to the base, and paste it into **Personal access token**.
2. Open the table in a web browser. The address has the form `https://airtable.com/appXXXXXXXX/tblXXXXXXXX/viwXXXXXXXX`: the part starting `app` is the **Base ID**, the part starting `tbl` is the table ID (or type the table's name).
3. Optionally choose a **View** (its name or `viw` ID) to read only that view's records in its order, or a **Filter formula** such as `{Status} = 'Open'`.

Lists and objects (attachments, linked records, collaborators, multiple selects) arrive as JSON text. Airtable leaves empty values out of a record, so they arrive empty; an unticked checkbox arrives as false.

options.name: token
options.title: Personal access token
options.description: An Airtable personal access token with the data.records:read scope and access to the base.

options.name: base_id
options.title: Base ID
options.description: The ID of the base: the part of the table's web address that starts with "app", for example appA1b2C3d4E5f6G7.

options.name: table
options.title: Table name or ID
options.description: The table's name, exactly as shown in Airtable, or its ID (the part of the address that starts with "tbl").

options.name: view
options.title: View
options.description: Optional. A view's name or ID (starts with "viw"): only the records in that view are read, in its order.

options.name: filter_formula
options.title: Filter formula
options.description: Optional. An Airtable formula; only records for which it is true are read, for example {Status} = 'Open'.

options.name: page_size
options.title: Page size
options.description: Records per request, from 1 to 100 (Airtable's maximum). All pages are read whatever the size.

blockOutputs.label: Records
blockOutputs.tooltip: One record per Airtable record: the record ID, then the table's fields. Lists and objects as JSON text.
